Renamed `totalAmount` → `grossAmount` across the stack:

- `api/src/main/java/mn/shop/api/Order.java:15,27` — field and getter (`getTotalAmount` → `getGrossAmount`)
- `api/src/main/java/mn/shop/api/OrderDto.java:5,8` — record component and the `of(Order)` mapping
- `api/src/main/resources/graphql/order.graphqls:4` — schema field
- `web/src/lib/orders.ts:6,25` — `ORDERS_QUERY` selection and the `Order` interface
- `web/src/components/OrderSummary.tsx:4,12` — the reduce and the rendered cell

Backend `mvn test` passes (`OrderDtoTest`, 1 test, 0 failures). The web checks couldn't run — `tsc` and `vitest` aren't installed in `web/node_modules`, so `npm run build` and `npm test` both fail with "not found" rather than on my changes. `npm install` would be needed to verify those.

Two deliberate non-edits:

- `web/src/generated/graphql-generated.ts:11` still says `totalAmount`. It's a codegen artifact regenerated from `order.graphqls`, and nothing imports it, so hand-editing it would be overwritten anyway — it'll pick up the rename on the next codegen run. There's no codegen script in `web/package.json` (`build` is just `tsc --noEmit`), so if that file is meant to stay in sync you may want to wire one up.
- `web/src/lib/orders.test.ts:9` mentions `totalAmount` only inside a comment explaining why the test avoids naming the field. No assertion depends on it.

One thing to flag: `Order.grossAmount` has no `@Column`, so JPA derives the column name from the field — the implied column changes from `total_amount` to `gross_amount`. There are no migrations or `schema.sql` in the repo, so I couldn't tell whether a real database backs this. If one does, it needs either a migration or `@Column(name = "total_amount")` on the field.
